140460101.text: Um, why are we here so early? Our meeting with Vaneigem isn't for a while...

140460102.text: I wanted to check on Escoffier...

140460103.text: Huh? Check on her? Why, what happened?

140460105.text: Oh no! Escoffier! Are you alright?

140460106.text: ...I'm fine... Just need to get some more coffee in me...

140460107.text: You really did pull an all-nighter, then...

140460108.text: Huh? What happened to my coffee? ...Did I really drink it all?

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to Hotel Debord and look for Escoffier

140460401.text: Hello! What can I get for you?

140460403.text: Sure thing. For here or to go?

140460406.text: Huh? Ohh, I see... First cup of the season, huh? Yeah, I get it. Young people these days do love their little surprises, hehe...

140460407.text: (...? Not convinced we're on the same page here. But I'm not here to chat — let's get this coffee to Escoffier!)

140460501.text: #Phew... I feel much better now! Thank you so much, {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

140460502.text: Glad to hear it... But make sure to catch up on your sleep when you get the chance!

140460504.text: Heh... I think I've figured out where the problem lies. Honestly, it's ridiculous, I don't know whether to laugh or cry...

140460505.text: Wait, what investigation? What are you guys talking about?

140460506.text: I'll save it for when everyone else gets here. It's so stupidly small, I can't believe it's caused so much drama...

140460509.text: Ahem... Yes, except my failures were stepping stones to success!

140460511.text: Huh? No, not since yesterday... Why, what's wrong?

140460512.text: After seeing her home yesterday, we were all a little concerned about how she was doing... so, I dropped by her place early this morning to check on her...

140460513.text: Only to find an empty house with the doors wide open!

140460514.text: I left Alphonse and the others to keep watch at her home while I check the Hotel Debord... I'm worried something bad might have happened...

140460515.text: If she's not here... then where could she be?

140460517.text: Alphonse? You're supposed to be keeping watch at Savanna's house...

140460518.text: We were, but then... just after you left, we found this stuff in her house!

140460519.text: Oh... Looks like a map, with a bunch of random places circled... What does it mean?

140460520.text: Wait a second, this feels familiar... I'm sure these places are all connected somehow...

140460521.text: Ah! Of course, from the Codex... They're all places that Modeste explored on his adventures!

subQuests.subQuestName: Find a way to get underwater

140460601.text: Whoa... This place looks like an underwater restaurant, doesn't it? Suddenly, the idea of an adventure-chef finding secret ingredients makes a whole lot more sense...

140460602.text: I think Modeste's Codex mentioned this place... a public bath from the time of Remuria. So yeah, definitely the kind of place that would have served food and drinks...

140460603.text: Huh? Some Blubberbeasts have come to join the party... How did they get here?

140460608.text: That could be easier said than done... Something's blocking the entrance.

140460609.text: Hmm... Well, did Modeste mention it in his adventure logs by any chance? They must have gotten through somehow.

140460610.text: Good point... Umm... Yes, that's right, it's coming back to me now...

140460611.text: "We prepared a banquet for our shy little guests... And as the food flowed away on the current, they broke into a joyous chorus, and the path opened to us."

140460612.text: Uhh... We have to feed the Blubberbeasts? With what? There's nothing here besides rocks, Romaritime Flowers, and Lumitoile...

140460613.text: ...See, this is why you should always bring snacks — you never know when you're gonna need 'em! Now, we have to head all the way back to shore and grab some!

140460614.text: There's no time for that. Romaritime Flowers and Lumitoile will have to do... They may not look appetizing to us, but who knows — they could be Blubberbeast delicacies!

140460615.text: Huh? Wait, we're seriously gonna try this?

140460616.text: You collect the Romaritime Flowers and Lumitoiles in the surrounding area...

140461901.text: Uh... Ugh... What's this? Hmm... I know some people like to use pungent flavors to wake themselves up, but... Not for me, thank you very much.

subQuests.subQuestName: Make a dish for the Blubberbeast

140460701.text: Uh... Blubberbeasts or not, are we sure this stuff is edible?

140460702.text: Hehe... Trust me, they'll love it!

140460703.text: More pertinently... How do we actually feed it to them?

140460704.text: Good question... If we try to put them in the pool, we'll probably just scare them off again, and who knows how long they'll be gone...

140460705.text: Yes, we can't afford to wait for them to double back... What was it that Modeste said again? Something about the food "flowing away on the current."

subQuests.subQuestName: Use the waterway to transport dishes

140462201.text: Mmm... Strong, bitter coffee beans, transformed through expert brewing, and balanced perfectly with rich, creamy steamed milk... Wonderful!

subQuests.subQuestName: Make a dish for the Blubberbeast

140460901.text: Phew... Hey, give me your water.

140460903.text: Hmm? I said YOUR water. The one you just drank out of.

140460906.text: All those years slaving away under Escoffier, and then you... Hmph, today, it's finally paying off!

140460907.text: Not only have I found the ruin that Savelli kept hidden... but I also get to boss you around like my little lapdog.

140460909.text: Hey, go scout ahead for me. If we need to do any more blast-tunneling, I want to know where to lay the explosives.

140460911.text: Did you not hear me? Get going!

140460913.text: Oh? When did you learn to fight back? You're always so compliant when I give you instructions by letter...

140460914.text: That's because you threatened to expose me for the lumiline incident! I swear, If I'd known what you were planning, I'd never have...

140460915.text: Ha, don't be so self-righteous. Admit it, you've always been jealous of Escoffier! That's why you lapped up everything I told you...

140460916.text: You were terrified of her finding out about your part in the lumiline incident, and you resented the way her reputation hung over you...

140460917.text: So you jumped at the chance to convince yourself that she was the villain, that she deliberately hid her secret recipes from you just to hold you back... It was the only excuse you needed to justify getting back at her!

140460918.text: First idolization, then jealousy, suspicion, and self-deception... That's what this comes down to. It was the same story with Savelli and my ancestor!

140460919.text: He offered Modeste his friendship, only to murder him out of vanity...

140460920.text: He promised to explore the world with him, only to later destroy all records of their adventures... It's a miracle I even found this place! You have no idea, the countless hours I spent piecing it all together...

140460921.text: ...Hmph, so you see? You're no better than Savelli. If you can't beat 'em, betray 'em, right?

140460922.text: ...I am no Savelli, nor will I ever be.

140460923.text: Oh, put a lid on it! You really think you can absolve yourself of your vindictive and jealous behavior now? Just because you finally realize that Escoffier never kept any secrets from you?

140460924.text: You didn't show any remorse when she left, or in the cooking contest. Why start now? You have no right to redemption!

140460925.text: You're right, I don't deserve her forgiveness... But I am done being bullied into submission by YOU!

140460926.text: Ooh, feisty. But you should watch your tone. Talking to me like that could get you in big trouble.

140460927.text: I somehow doubt that... Since I poisoned both our water bottles.

140460929.text: Ever since I learned the truth... I've been biding my time, waiting for this moment! You've played me like a fiddle for so long... and now, this is payback!

140460930.text: But... But you drank it too!

140460931.text: ...It's what we both deserve. This is the price we must pay for betraying Escoffier... You'll die here with me, Monica!

140460935.text: Haha... Ahh, you're too much. I thought I'd play along for a bit just to amuse myself. You gave a very rousing performance.

140460936.text: I saw your dumb plan a mile off. There's no poison in these bottles, just clean, fresh water.

140460938.text: Revenge is a dish best served cold, you know... did you really think your half-baked plot would fool me?

140460939.text: You're a lousy chef, and you make a lousy villain too. A complete waste of space... No wonder you never amounted to anything.

140460940.text: Everything I ever did was a failure... and now, I've failed again, for the last time...

140460941.text: Hey, why don't you try your hand at being a comedian in your next life? You got a good laugh outta me, heh. But now the show's over...

140460942.text: You should have just done like I asked, Savanna. All I wanted you to do was scout the ruins for me... But you had your chance, and now it's time to say goodbye!

140460944.text: Let her go, Monica! We've got you surrounded!

140460946.text: Ugh! Looks like I'll have to keep you around for a little longer.

140460948.text: Stay back if you want her alive!

140460949.text: #Escoffier and {NICKNAME}... Hmph, I can't take you both on in combat, but if you so much as flinch, I can end Savanna's life in a heartbeat!

140460950.text: Monica... What are you hoping to achieve by this? You're about to commit murder — and for what? A recipe!?

140460951.text: A recipe? Hah! You chefs are all blinded by your myopic focus on kitchen affairs. Well, some of us actually have bigger fish to fry...

140460952.text: Modeste had a secret... the truth behind his so-called genius, the "je ne sais quoi" factor in his Gateau Debord... and it's right here in these ruins!

140460953.text: ...Are you serious? You're here because of a Gateau Debord obsession? You've gone completely mad!

140460954.text: Hahaha, I couldn't care less about the cake itself. No, the real treasure is the secret ingredient that Modeste sourced from these ruins!

140460955.text: He and Savelli were fools. A priceless treasure of Remuria in the palms of their hands, and they thought "Ooh, this would go great in our cake mix"!

140460956.text: We're talking about a powerful stimulant that also sharpens the senses. That's no cooking ingredient... it's a groundbreaking drug!

140460957.text: That's right, I've done my research... It was a drug that Remuria developed for their war machine. I could make a killing by selling it to the Treasure Hoarders or the Fatui!

140460958.text: Will you listen to yourself? You're completely delusional!

140460959.text: Hmph, my eyes are wide open! Just wait till I get my hands on this treasure, you'll see what a fool you've been!

140460961.text: *cough* Just when I thought she couldn't get any crazier... She's lucky the whole place didn't collapse!

140460965.text: Monica must have taken her... Ugh, what a coward! She's only taking her hostage because she knows that she's no match for you!

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for a way forward nearby

140460801.text: "...Following the exalted Harmost (...) order, and in accordance with our Sebastos's most sacred, most benevolent temper, we establish here a (...) as condolences for the naturalized barbarian soldiers... Savages they may have been, but they were also warriors."

140460802.text: "...With this secret treasure, granted graciously... the warriors' bodily desires are satisfied, that they may fight on with hundredfold bravery..."

subQuests.subQuestName: Make a dish for the Blubberbeast
Use the waterway to transport dishes
Make a dish for the Blubberbeast

140461201.text: That's strange... these don't look Remurian to me. More like last-century Fontaine.

140461204.text: Adventurers from last-century Fontaine, huh... *gasp* Modeste and Savelli! Do you think they camped here?

140461205.text: By the looks of it, this was a one-person camp. They adventured together, but... maybe one of them came back alone at a later date?

140461301.text: ...The Treasure of Remuria... I have found you at last!

140461302.text: Hahaha! Savelli, you tried your best to bury the truth, but you underestimated the children of Modeste! Some fragments of his diary escaped your clutches, and we have held onto them for generations!

140461303.text: Heh... But I have to thank you too, Savanna. Without your help retrieving the Codex, and with it the last piece of the puzzle, I may never have found this place...

140461304.text: But now, finally, the secret to Remuria's military might is within my grasp... the Treasure of Remuria is mine!

140461308.text: Monica...! Ugh, we were seconds too late!

140461309.text: Escoffier? What's the deal with that jar?

140461310.text: ...Savelli's final act... He wanted to conceal the secret of the treasure forevermore, and make sure it would never harm anyone again...

140461311.text: So he came here after his friend's death, and destroyed every last shred that remained!

140461312.text: ...This can't be happening! All the years I spent piecing together the truth... All my painstaking planning...

140461313.text: All that... for an empty jar!?

140461314.text: Monica! Don't do anything stupid! This ruin is more dangerous than you realize...

140461401.text: Aaah! Why is this place still shaking!?

140461404.text: Hmph! Either way, it's all her fault!

140461405.text: #Enough chit-chat, let's get outta here! {NICKNAME}, Escoffier, come on!

140461407.text: ...Oh no you don't! Hah... If I can't get what I want, neither will any of you!

140461408.text: Hahaha... I've got nothing to show for my life's work so far. But if I can take another so-called genius down with me in my final moment... then it was all worth it!

140461414.text: ...I may be a lousy chef, but it looks like I'm not a complete waste of space.

140461504.text: Vaneigem? What are you all doing here...?

140461505.text: #*sigh* What did you expect us to do? Stay at the restaurant and sit on our merry derrieres? While {NICKNAME} and Escoffier were out here risking their lives?

140461506.text: We had to do something... even though that something ended up being, well, waiting for you here instead... Haha.

140461507.text: I... I don't deserve any of you... and I certainly don't deserve to be your head chef...

140461508.text: It was my fault Escoffier had to leave... Then I couldn't live up to her standards... I acted like a tyrant in the kitchen... And now, I almost got myself killed...

140461509.text: ...Come back, Escoffier! Come and be our head chef again! I... I'll never be able to replace you!

140461510.text: Okay, so... Everything I said to you the day I left — it just went in one ear and out the other?

140461511.text: Huh? Sorry, I was kinda in my own head at the time... All I could think about was the lumiline situation... What was it you said, again...?

140461512.text: Forget it, it doesn't matter... Anyway, I didn't leave this job because of you. And... you're not nearly as awful a chef as you think.

140461513.text: If you were that bad, why would all your staff show up here for you?

140461514.text: Escoffier's right! Sure, you nitpick our work and get us to do things over a lot... but when it comes down to it, you're the one who's always doing whatever it takes to make sure the customers get served on time, every time!

140461515.text: Things were pretty rough after Escoffier left... and Savanna's the only reason we've been able to make it through.

140461516.text: Our customers know that Escoffier doesn't work for us anymore — but the fact is, they keep coming back. If that's not an endorsement of your work... I don't know what is.

140461517.text: At the end of the day, we're all human, and we all make mistakes. All we can do is recognize where we get it wrong, and do our best to improve... That's all that's humanly possible.

140461518.text: No, I... I get what you're saying but, what I did to Firmin, and to Escoffier... it's unforgiveable!

140461519.text: Well, about that... There's someone else here to see you, Chef.

140461522.text: ...I'm so sorry, I... I put far too much pressure on you. And the way I stubbornly refused to go and see you after you fell ill... there's no excuse.

140461523.text: But... I'm too late, aren't I? The damage is done. I heard that... you can't even hold a kitchen knife anymore...

140461524.text: Actually... I think I'm going to be just fine.

140461526.text: We thought Firmin's problem was purely psychological in nature, but after the threat letter came to light, it got Firmin thinking... and then, he remembered the tea that Monica used to give him every night.

140461527.text: And as it turns out... She was lacing it with lumiline the whole time.

140461528.text: No way... Doesn't that cause nerve damage?

140461529.text: It can. High doses pose a risk of serious nervous and sensory complications, but if you calculate the dosage carefully, you can control the extent of its effects...

140461530.text: A small dose might simply make a person more emotional, whether that mean more fragile or more hot-tempered...

140461531.text: No wonder it seemed like you'd lost your edge...

140461532.text: Haha... I asked my friends at the Fontaine Research Institute about it — they said that with the low dose I was taking, the risks are pretty small. They also fixed me up with some meds, and said I should recover in no time.

140461533.text: You're already sounding a lot more confident.

140461534.text: Heh, well that's what happens when you give someone a little bit of hope to cling on to.

140461535.text: There's... more. We believe that... Firmin was likely not Monica's only victim.

140461536.text: You mean... She poisoned me, too?

140461537.text: Ohh... So THAT'S why Savanna's been so irritable this whole time!

140461538.text: Hmph, let's not be too quick to blame everything on the lumiline. That stuff can only amplify what's already there. So tasty food will seem like the most delicious thing in the world, while food you don't particularly care for will become utterly revolting...

140461539.text: So you'd better make sure you reflect on your behavior, and apologize to every single person you've wronged.

140461542.text: ...I'm sorry, there's still one question that's really bugging me. Why is it... that no matter what I do, my Gateau Debord never tastes the same as yours?

140461543.text: Is it just... I mean, is it because... you're a genius, and I'm not?

140461545.text: It's because the heating element in your oven is broken, you silly goose.

140461549.text: I felt like something was off during the cooking contest. Once I got around to checking all the equipment, I noticed it right away: There was a half-degree discrepancy between the temperature setting and the actual temperature.

140461550.text: All the ovens in the whole kitchen had the same problem, which confused me at the time. But by this point, it's pretty obvious that Monica must have tampered with them.

140461551.text: I would have figured it out the day of the bake-off, since the issue affected both our teams... But of course, Monica sabotaged mine so that could never happen.

140461553.text: I spent so long trying to find out where I was going wrong, and then you pinpoint the problem in just one night...

140461554.text: ...It all comes back to one simple, undeniable truth: You're a genius, and I'm just plain old Savanna.

140461555.text: Oh, cut it out! Stop the "woe is me" act for a second and just think. I came up with this recipe. You don't think that might have something to do with it?

140461556.text: Do you know how long I spent perfecting my Gateau Debord? Three years. Three whole years! I know this dish inside out, back to front, and upside down.

140461557.text: And you've been head chef now for what, six months? If that? A couple hundred failed attempts, and you're gonna throw in the kitchen towel? And declare, you'll never be successful because you're not a genius?

140461558.text: You clearly have no idea how many kitchen failures I have under my belt! Or just how long it took me to finally get my recipe to a level I was satisfied with.

140461559.text: Genius or not, everyone makes mistakes. Modeste did, Savelli did, everyone does.

140461560.text: You're only a lousy chef if you don't face up to your mistakes, learn from them, and then keep chipping away until you crack the problem once and for all.

140461561.text: Surely you haven't forgotten all that? You were no lousy chef back when I handed you the reins!

140461563.text: ...I haven't forgotten. And I'll make sure I never do.

140461565.text: Haha! Sounds like we won't need another changing of the guard in the Hotel Debord kitchen any time soon. Huzzah!

140461566.text: Aww... What a perfect ending to a crazy journey... Look how happy everyone is!

140461567.text: Hmph... So, got your mojo back now?

140461568.text: Yeah... Thanks to you, Escoffier. In fact, no... thanks to all of you.

140461569.text: Ahh, friends again! So nice to see them finally settle their beef.

140461572.text: Good. So, now that's out the way...

140461573.text: It's time for payback! You cheated in our last bake-off, and I demand a rematch, right now!

140461578.text: But... But that was mostly Monica's fault, wasn't it?

140461579.text: Right, and also... Does it have to be right now? Savanna's only just got her mojo back, and you barely escaped from a death trap...

140461580.text: No excuses! This is a cooking contest between two top chefs, and nothing will stand in its way!

140461581.text: So grab your spatula and get ready — 'cause this rematch is happening, today! Right now! This instant!

140461582.text: Hey! So, um... This whole time you were salty about losing...

140461601.text: ...The results are in. A landslide victory for Escoffier!

140461602.text: Hmph, quite rightly too. Piece of cake.

140461603.text: (Her tail seems very happy with the results.)

140461604.text: Oh yeah, look at that... And Savanna looks pretty chipper too, considering she lost!

140461608.text: Ahem! Now, where were we? Ah yes, do you have any more questions for me, after everything that's happened?

140450701.text: Heh... Thank you for your words of encouragement. I'm gonna head to the Hotel Debord and spend the night investigating. I guess I'll see you tomorrow.

140450702.text: "Genius"? Ugh. Calling someone a genius is just another way of saying, "I'm too lazy to figure out how I need to improve." It's a defeatist attitude, and I won't stand for it!

140459918.text: That should be enough flavoring... Now hurry up and balance the flavors.

140461101.text: "...The barbarians who take the (...) are gradually losing part of (...) ... There is no cause for worry."

140461102.text: "...The desire to break free from forms of flesh and blood... is also the first step to guiding them toward accepting civilization..."

140469901.text: Well, there's cooking facilities here, or we could just grab a cup of coffee from Café Lutece... But either way, hurry!

140469902.text: We should be getting close to the spot marked on the map!

140469903.text: Gah, of all the stupid things she's done, this really takes the cake! The moment we find her, I am going to curse the living daylights out of her!

140469904.text: She's a nutcase! A liability to herself and everyone else...

140469905.text: #Well, now it's up to us to clean up the mess she's made — take these golems out, {NICKNAME}!
